sources.role: Content and official skills; publisher-linked PDF has 111 pages and 2020 copyright.

administrative_routing.unmapped_target: Hold question for classification review; do not force an incidental topic tag.
administrative_routing.novel_passage_context: Store free-text context separately; tag the tested reasoning and knowledge, not unfamiliar entities merely named.

analytics_defaults.first_exposure_determined_over: Lifetime history before applying date or recent-window filters
analytics_defaults.deduplicate_by: question_family_id and learner_id within selected attempt policy
analytics_defaults.attempt_policy: First-ever scored exposure to each question family, eligible only if unaided and without prior answer, hint, or solution exposure. Repeated versions and retries recorded separately.
analytics_defaults.parent_rollup: Union of unique eligible question-family attempts, never sum displayed child percentages or double-count overlapping tags.
analytics_defaults.threshold_status: Provisional product heuristics; not AAMC rules or statistical validation.
analytics_defaults.small_sample_display: Neutral or muted cell with Limited evidence, counts, and observed accuracy. Never treat unattempted topics as zero accuracy.
analytics_defaults.label: Performance on questions targeting this topic
analytics_defaults.secondary_topic_display: Exploratory performance on questions involving the topic; not a diagnosis of which concept caused an error.
